questions.stem:
The following table shows values of $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ for different values of $x$.

Both $f$ and $g$ are one-to-one functions.

| $x$ | $-2$ | $0$ | $3$ | $4$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| $f(x)$ | $8$ | $4$ | $0$ | $-3$ |
| $g(x)$ | $-5$ | $-2$ | $4$ | $0$ |

parts.label: c
parts.text: Find the value of $x$ such that $f(x) = 0$.

questions.stem: A function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = \dfrac{2x - 1}{x + 1}$, where $x \in \mathbb{R}$, $x \neq -1$.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
The graph of $y = f(x)$ has a vertical asymptote and a horizontal asymptote.

Write down the equation of

(i) the vertical asymptote;

(ii) the horizontal asymptote.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
On the set of axes below, sketch the graph of $y = f(x)$.

On your sketch, clearly indicate the asymptotes and the position of any points of intersection with the axes.

![Empty grid with x and y from −6 to 6.](content/papers/img/2022-may-p1-tz2-q4-grid.png)
Find the least positive value of $x$ for which $\cos\left(\dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$.

questions.stem:
The following diagram shows part of the graph of a quadratic function $f$.

The graph of $f$ has its vertex at $(3,\ 4)$, and it passes through point Q as shown.

![Upward parabola f with vertex (3, 4) above the x-axis and a point Q on the right branch.](content/papers/img/2022-may-p1-tz2-q7.png)

parts.label: a
parts.text: Write down the equation of the axis of symmetry.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
The function can be written in the form $f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k$.

(i) Write down the values of $h$ and $k$.

(ii) Point Q has coordinates $(5,\ 12)$. Find the value of $a$.

parts.label: c
parts.intro: The line $L$ is tangent to the graph of $f$ at Q.

parts.label: d
parts.intro: Now consider another function $y = g(x)$. The derivative of $g$ is given by $g'(x) = f(x) - d$, where $d \in \mathbb{R}$.
parts.text: Find the values of $d$ for which $g$ is an increasing function.

parts.label: e
parts.text: Find the values of $x$ for which the graph of $g$ is concave-up.
